title: Claude expands design capabilities with six free open-source skills #claudeai #opendesign #aidesign
description: Claude offers six free open-source skills that transform it into a complete design team. These include adding motion to components, generating layouts and charts, auditing code with Vercel’s design rules, creating full design boards from ideas, extracting styles from public websites, and converting screenshots into functional websites without losing details. These capabilities streamline design workflows by combining automation, design intelligence, and code quality checks. By integrating these tools, designers and developers can accelerate project delivery while maintaining visual and technical standards. This innovation exemplifies how AI can enhance creativity and efficiency in digital product design. Comment "design" to receive access to all six skills and start optimizing your design process with Claude’s versatile toolkit. #ClaudeAI #DesignAutomation #OpenSourceDesign #AIForDesign #Vercel #DesignTools #UXUIDesign #WebDesignAI #DesignSystem #CreativeAI #DesignWorkflow #AIProductivity #DesignTech #NoCodeAI #DigitalDesign
